mesh_to_surface.method: Exact in-memory charts split at C0 parameter knots, coarse seeds, Newton projection, convex-control-hull AABB fallback, original face classifier and exact trim correction; sampled OCCT whole-region cross-check. Exported B-Rep faces are not split.

interior_continuity.note: Cubic simple knots are C2 by construction. Reported finite-offset jumps at repeated knots are sampled diagnostics, not a continuous-domain proof.

regularity.note: Dense derivative checks and kernel BRepCheck do not prove continuous injectivity.

normal_source: Area-weighted mesh vertex normals; reverse facet normals separately reported
